author: claude
body: The footer now reads **Hifth is open source, under the GNU GPL.** The GPL's "free" means free to read and change, but visitors read it as "costs nothing". Changed in `apps/landing/index.html`, commit 382adfe3. A new test (`scripts/landing-page.test.mjs`) fails if any landing page calls Hifth free again. There's an after picture in the thread.
